title: Add the price range for the storefront filter
description: The storefront's price slider needs its ends. Adds GET /api/products/price-range with the lowest and highest product price, or nulls when there are no products. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: `Array.prototype.sort()` with no comparator sorts numbers as strings, so prices with different numbers of digits come out wrong (900 and 1200 give min 1200, max 900); use `(a, b) => a - b`, or let the database compute `_min` and `_max`.
